correctness.rationale: The frozen main formulas are mathematically correct under the stated resonant, phase-locked, equal-bath assumptions. The normal modes have anomalous moments γM/(γ±2iJ), with M=−y sinh(2r)/2, giving local anomaly μM and intermode anomaly −iχM. Equal local quadrature blocks can be made isotropic by identical local symplectic scalings; a common rotation diagonalizes the cross block to diag(c,−c), with |c|=|χM|. Partial transposition makes that cross block scalar, giving the smaller symplectic eigenvalue sqrt((y cosh(2r)/2)^2−(μM)^2)−|c|. In the repair, writing t=tanh(2r), the difference between the squared first radical and the square of sqrt(1−t)+t sqrt(μ(1−μ)) is t(sqrt(1−μ)−sqrt((1−t)μ))². Both sides of the square-root comparison are nonnegative. For 0<t<1 the unique equality is μ=1/(2−t), or J=γ sqrt(1−t)/2, yielding 2ν̃_−=y/sqrt(1+t). At r=0 all J are equivalent; for r>0 the strict PPT threshold and, when positive, unique negativity maximum follow. The frozen high-squeezing window is a limiting, not a finite-r, window. The uploaded verifier was inspected, not executed; its recorded 1057 finite checks are not proofs. The repaired RESULT and verification notes bound the claim to the exact prescribed-squeezing optimization.
